note: A strict build over register 1 (#1736). Owners a and b of variable 5 share the source name 'Svar'. Owner a's operational definition is 239 characters, so 'Svar — <definition>' is past the 200-character search cap (#1261) and the ladder takes its first sentence instead. That sentence runs past three periods that close abbreviations (fr.o.m., ca., t.ex.), each followed by an upper-case word, and ends at 'register.'. Owner b's short definition takes the first step.
fails_if: the ladder writes an over-cap name (a gets variable_name_over_search_cap), skips the first-sentence step (a becomes 'Svar (A)'), or cuts at an abbreviation's period (a becomes 'Svar — Antal anställda fr.o.m', '… ca' or '… t.ex')

sources.description: Variable 5, named 'Svar', delivers A (CVID 21, a 239-character operational definition whose first sentence ends at 'register.') and B (CVID 22, 'Alternativ B') in edition 2020.
